question: D08 2025 年二季度入住率和平均房价，跟上年同期比怎么样？
answer: D08 2025 年二季度入住率 64.2%，上年同期 68.9%，下降 11.4 个百分点；同期市场基准 63.2%，上年同期 63.2%。平均房价 305.99 元，上年同期 289.45 元；同期市场均价 318.17 元 → 324.42 元。

steps.purpose: D08 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30 与上年同期：入住率 / 平均房价 / 市场基准
steps.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
p1(d) AS (SELECT '2024-04-01' UNION ALL SELECT date(d,'+1 day') FROM p1 WHERE d < '2024-06-30'),
p2(d) AS (SELECT '2025-04-01' UNION ALL SELECT date(d,'+1 day') FROM p2 WHERE d < '2025-06-30'),
sell AS (
  SELECT l.listing_id, 'prev' AS period, COUNT(*) AS n FROM listings l JOIN p1 d
    ON d.d >= l.online_date AND (l.offline_date IS NULL OR d.d < l.offline_date)
  WHERE l.district_id = 'D08' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owner_blocks b
        WHERE b.listing_id = l.listing_id AND d.d BETWEEN b.start_date AND b.end_date)
  GROUP BY l.listing_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.listing_id, 'cur', COUNT(*) FROM listings l JOIN p2 d
    ON d.d >= l.online_date AND (l.offline_date IS NULL OR d.d < l.offline_date)
  WHERE l.district_id = 'D08' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owner_blocks b
        WHERE b.listing_id = l.listing_id AND d.d BETWEEN b.start_date AND b.end_date)
  GROUP BY l.listing_id
), sold AS (
  SELECT l.listing_id, 'prev' AS period, SUM(b.nights) AS nights, SUM(b.total_amount) AS amount
  FROM bookings b JOIN listings l ON l.listing_id = b.listing_id
  WHERE b.status = '完成' AND b.checkin_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-06-30'
    AND l.district_id = 'D08' GROUP BY l.listing_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.listing_id, 'cur', SUM(b.nights), SUM(b.total_amount)
  FROM bookings b JOIN listings l ON l.listing_id = b.listing_id
  WHERE b.status = '完成' AND b.checkin_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30'
    AND l.district_id = 'D08' GROUP BY l.listing_id
), occ AS (
  SELECT s.period, 1.0 * SUM(COALESCE(so.nights,0)) / SUM(s.n) AS occupancy,
         1.0 * SUM(COALESCE(so.amount,0)) / SUM(COALESCE(so.nights,0)) AS adr
  FROM sell s LEFT JOIN sold so ON so.listing_id = s.listing_id AND so.period = s.period
  GROUP BY s.period
)
SELECT (SELECT ROUND(occupancy,4) FROM occ WHERE period='cur')  AS occupancy_cur,
       (SELECT ROUND(occupancy,4) FROM occ WHERE period='prev') AS occupancy_prev,
       (SELECT ROUND(adr,2)       FROM occ WHERE period='cur')  AS adr_cur,
       (SELECT ROUND(adr,2)       FROM occ WHERE period='prev') AS adr_prev,
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(occupancy_rate),4) FROM market_benchmark
         WHERE month BETWEEN '2025-04' AND '2025-06' AND district_id = 'D08') AS market_occupancy_cur,
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(occupancy_rate),4) FROM market_benchmark
         WHERE month BETWEEN '2024-04' AND '2024-06' AND district_id = 'D08') AS market_occupancy_prev,
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_price),2) FROM market_benchmark
         WHERE month BETWEEN '2025-04' AND '2025-06' AND district_id = 'D08') AS market_price_cur,
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_price),2) FROM market_benchmark
         WHERE month BETWEEN '2024-04' AND '2024-06' AND district_id = 'D08') AS market_price_prev,
       '2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30' AS period_cur, '2024-04-01 至 2024-06-30' AS period_prev
